data.name: Challenge
data.description: %1/day, a samurai can challenge a foe to combat. As a swift action, the samurai chooses one target within sight to challenge. The samurai's melee attacks deal %2 extra damage when made against the target of his challenge. Challenging a foe requires much of the samurai's concentration. The samurai takes a -2 penalty to his Armor Class, except against attacks made by the target of his challenge. The challenge remains in effect until the target is dead or unconscious, or until the combat ends.|SamuraiChallengeTimes|SamuraiChallengeDam
